about:
Founded in 1981 in Baltimore, Maryland, Avalon Industries remains a family-owned company organized around two distinct divisions. The business was established to manufacture protective carrying solutions and has grown to include a full-service promotional products operation.

The core manufacturing division produces soft-sided carrying cases, bags, totes, and molded laminate cases engineered to hold and transport supplies and equipment for commercial and military use. The second division, Avalon Promotional Products, operates as an advertising specialties distributor, providing personalized apparel, uniforms, and branded merchandise for brand identification and promotion campaigns.

For several years, both divisions have supplied the U.S. defense department, first-responder organizations, school systems, municipal governments, youth sports leagues, and a broad commercial client base. The manufacturer focuses on durable sewn and laminated case goods, while the promotional arm handles decoration, sourcing, and distribution of logoed apparel and merchandise.
